messages:
karen: Heads up: launching a new 'Compliance Artifact Extract' for Private/VPC tenants next week. Purpose: let authorized customer admins request a signed, redacted bundle from their on-prem agent for audits or legal needs. Opt-in, admin consent + signed addendum required.

karen: Canary window: 2026-05-05T09:00Z (10 tenants) -> broad rollout 2026-05-06. Agent requirement: v3.2+. Exports encrypted, HSM-wrapped signing, and subject to tenant DLP/redaction profiles.

maya: TL;DR limits: 1 concurrent export/tenant, 25GB max single bundle (we'll support chunked downloads for larger sets), rate limit 3 exports/hour per tenant.

tom: Ops note: adding export_queue_inflight metric and alert when backlog > 5. Also adding an emergency console toggle to pause exports per tenant.

infra: Action: update KMS policies to allow export-signing from onprem agent role, publish current verification public key at https://docs.redwood.internal/keys/export-verification.pub. We'll coordinate key-rotation schedule.

devops: Example API (customer-side):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://private-console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants/ORG/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","redaction":"pci","include_telemetry":false}'
```

cs-lead: CS will need: consent checkbox flow, admin identity record, and a short playbook for customers on how to request expedited exports. I'll schedule two office hours for customers next week.

legal-bot: Legal uploaded draft addendum to /legal/drafts/compliance-artifact-addendum.md. Do not distribute externally. We require the addendum signed before any telemetry-including exports.

sec: Security: verify signature verification steps in the runbook. Also ensure export artifacts include a manifest with SHA256 checksums and signer identity.

karen: SLA note: exports are background best-effort. Publish expected windows: <=24h for <2GB, <=48h for 2-25GB, larger via chunked delivery. Expedited path available with signed emergency addendum. No changes to inference SLOs.

maya: Ops runbook items: how to abort stuck exports, how to refresh agent KMS creds, and how to reassemble chunked bundles. I'll add those sections.

tom: I'll add a preflight check to the agent upgrade job to warn tenants with low disk or memory for large exports.

karen: Please ack this thread when you've completed your assigned items. DM me for demo tenant access. :white_check_mark:
